{{Top|leg}}
'''Vastiv''' was a type of bio-membrane created by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Shaper caste|shapers]] as a means of forming separate compartments aboard their [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. It was also possible to create the membrane in a large enough size so as to cover [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ships such as the [[yorik-trema]].
